artifacts.summary: Close-out plan for the REFUTED verdict: three phases, 2.25 hours -- re-measure the landed probe evidence, sweep the four records for consistency with the verdict and attest no weakened substitute, then write the completion summary under the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: When a verdict-first research task's dispatch deliverables all land inside the research round (probe written, registered, parent record corrected) and its one remaining step was explicitly conditional on a gate being survived, the plan round is a CLOSE-OUT round, not a proof round: three phases -- (1) re-measure the landed evidence in this dispatch rather than trusting the research round's 'measured this session' claims, (2) sweep every record that carries the verdict for mutual consistency plus a mechanical attestation that no weakened same-named substitute was published, (3) write the completion summary under the full gate set. Two checks before planning prevent wasted scope: read state.json for sibling tasks that may already have discharged a recorded user ruling (a successor record may exist and be completed), and re-derive every count carried from the research report (a probe-collection count goes stale as soon as a sibling round adds a probe).
